title: Adaptive Cost Gatekeeper: dynamic batching & caching default profiles with unit-economics estimator
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Introduce Adaptive Cost Gatekeeper: server-side defaults for batching+KV caching, quantization recommendation hooks, and a lightweight unit-economics estimator. No user-facing API changes; rollout gated behind config flags.
description: Motivation: customers repeatedly request safer, production-ready defaults that reduce per-token costs without regressing latency. This PR introduces the Adaptive Cost Gatekeeper, a small runtime component that synthesizes workload signals (median seq-len, request hotness, p95 latency budget) and emits recommended batching, prefix-caching, and quantization tier defaults per route. It also includes a unit-economics estimator used by the console to show projected cost delta for suggested changes. What this PR does: 1) adds gatekeeper daemon that watches RPS/sequence distributions and proposes defaults, 2) implements a conservative batching policy (max_batch_size and preferred_batch_timeout heuristics), 3) adds prefix/KV cache suggestion logic and cache key fingerprinting to avoid over-caching low-cardinality routes, 4) adds quantization recommendation hooks (FP16/INT8 preference hints) tied to observed quality deltas from eval harness, 5) surfaces estimator events to observability and console telemetry, 6) feature flags and rollout plan. Checklist: [x] gatekeeper core daemon and gRPC API; [x] conservative heuristics for production safety; [x] unit-economics estimator and telemetry events; [x] integration tests for batching/caching toggles; [x] console wiring (backend) for preview; [ ] console UI polish (follow-up). Related: Linear ENG-1294, ENG-1321; incident reference SUP-887 for cost spike patterns. Deployment notes: flag-guarded; start in opt-in mode for Dedicated customers and opt-out canary for hosted accounts. No breaking API changes. Merge method: squash.

summary: Adds a runtime component that recommends safe batching, caching, and quantization defaults and a unit-economics estimator to preview cost impact; flag-gated rollout.
notes_for_ops: Start rollout in 'suggestion' mode for hosted small tenants, enable enforcement for Dedicated 1-week canaries only after metrics show stable p95 and no increase in 5xx. Watch metrics: gatekeeper.suggestions.applied, unit_econ.estimated_delta, runtime.batch.size.p95. If errors spike, rollback gatekeeper.enforce -> false.
